title_en: xingshu-he: Astra passes at 6.7 min with an offline brush copy; Luna plateaus at IoU 0.788 after 112 min
title_zh: 行书「和」：Astra 借离线笔刷副本 6.7 分钟通过；Luna 112 分钟后停在 IoU 0.788
caption_en: Every simulator score each agent printed, over wall minutes (scores.py over trajectory.json; minutes from monitor_row agent_start, the analysts' digest origin). Astra (blue): brushfit.cpp fit 'IOU 0.6289' at 2.8 min -> 0.9249 at 4.05; robot run 1 at 4.6 min scores 0.925119 (BF 0.905, but one region 0.325), the copy had predicted 0.925; refit, robot run 2 at 6.72 min: IoU 0.960846, BF 0.973, min region 0.967, '[6.8] passes every scoring threshold'. Luna (orange): 64 distinct scored simulator runs, IoU 0.636 (7.3 min) -> 0.772 (63-68 min) -> 0.788; BF never above 0.567. Its submitted attempt (red ring, 107.8 min) = grader 0.78778 / BF 0.525; '[112.2] The trajectory does not meet image success'. 74-93 min: a per-stroke shift search that printed no full scores.
caption_zh: 两个智能体在日志里打印的每一次模拟器评分，横轴为墙钟分钟。Astra 先写了 C++ 笔刷副本 brushfit.cpp，离线拟合从 2.8 分钟的 0.629 升到 4.05 分钟的 0.925；4.6 分钟第一次真机运行得 0.925（副本预测同为 0.925），但有一个区域只有 0.325；修正后 6.72 分钟第二次运行 IoU 0.961、边界 F 0.973，全部达标。Luna 共跑出 64 个不同的评分，IoU 从 0.636 慢慢爬到 0.788，边界 F 始终不超过 0.567；最后提交的那次（红圈，107.8 分钟）评分器给 0.788 / 0.525，112.2 分钟它自己承认未达到图像成功标准。

moment.quote: [6.8] The revised run passes every scoring threshold: 0.961 IoU, 0.973 boundary F, and at least 96.7% coverage in every region.

luna.quote: [112.2] The trajectory does not meet image success ... boundary F is 0.525

mapping: No frames: x = minute of the trajectory.json step whose tool output printed the score; Astra's final trajectory has 1947 control steps (20 Hz -> 97.35 s sim). Series in tools/rp1_series.json.

title_en: xingshu-he privileged: final sheets over the target (Astra, Luna, Opus)
title_zh: 行书「和」特权模式：三份最终纸面与范本叠加（Astra、Luna、Opus）
caption_en: Target, then each final main sheet over it: black = ink on target, aqua = target not inked, orange = ink outside. Astra (7.5 min) IoU 0.961 BF 0.973; Opus (26.3 min, also an exact brush copy) 0.956 / 0.985; Luna (112 min) 0.788 / 0.525, min region 0.58: the wrong stroke shapes (the 禾 left sweep and the 口 loop) show as aqua/orange bands that a translation or press sweep cannot remove. Recomputed IoU from canvas.png: 0.9611 / 0.7880 / 0.9560 vs reward.json 0.9608 / 0.7878 / 0.9561.
caption_zh: 左为范本，其余为三个智能体的最终纸面叠在范本上：黑色为重合，青色为漏墨，橙色为溢墨。Astra（7.5 分钟）IoU 0.961、边界 F 0.973；Opus（26.3 分钟，同样复刻了笔刷）0.956 / 0.985；Luna（112 分钟）0.788 / 0.525，最小区域 0.58。Luna 的问题在笔画形状（禾的左撇、口的转折），整体平移或调压力都消不掉这些青橙色带。

moment.quote: Both fresh replays passed with identical final states. ... IoU: 0.9608

title_en: caoshu-nangong standard (cap 5): rehearsal decides the one irreversible pass
title_zh: 草书「南宫」标准模式（上限 5 笔）：一次不可逆的书写，胜负在排练
caption_en: Row 1 Astra: practice sheet with 15 inked practice contacts (full-size curved copies; '[6.2] adjusting the tip's lead ahead of the hairs'), then the main sheet after each of its 5 contacts (verifier replay, canvas tile) with the cumulative camera IoU it measured itself: 0.058 (16.2 min), 0.536 (17.4), 0.631 (18.6), 0.832 (19.2), light retrace 0.834 (22.0); grader 0.845 PASS. Row 2 Luna: 2 straight practice lines, then 5 hand-placed passes with camera IoU 0.099, 0.152, 0.248, 0.326 (all measured at 24.6 min) and 0.410 (28.0 min); grader 0.425, BF 0.46, min region 0.20 FAIL. Red border = the 5th (last allowed) contact.
caption_zh: 上排 Astra：练习纸上 15 次全尺寸曲线排练（6.2 分钟时调整“笔尖领先于笔毫”的量），然后主纸上 5 笔，每笔后自己用相机测的累计 IoU 依次为 0.058、0.536、0.631、0.832，第 5 笔轻描补墨后 0.834，评分器 0.845 通过。下排 Luna：练习纸只画了 2 条直线测宽度，随后 5 笔手工定位，累计 IoU 0.099、0.152、0.248、0.326、0.410，评分器 0.425，边界 F 0.46，最小区域 0.20，失败。红框为第 5 笔，也就是上限内的最后一笔。

moment.quote: [19.6] Both characters are now written in four contacts. The camera estimate is about 0.83 IoU

luna.quote: [29.0] ... my camera-based comparison shows substantial uncovered ink and spill, so I can't claim the success thresholds were met

title_en: caoshu-wen standard: Astra's 3x3 grid proxy says pass; hidden region 7 fails at 0.790
title_zh: 草书「文」标准模式：Astra 自己的 3×3 网格显示达标，隐藏的第 7 区域只有 0.790
caption_en: Same final sheet twice. Left: the 3x3 grid Astra used as its region proxy (its compare_main.py at 15.6 min: u in [366, 655), v in [242, 782)), with the coverages it printed: minimum 0.828, so every cell >= 0.80; its whole-sheet estimate IoU 0.825 (grader 0.829). Right: the 9 reference stroke polygons the grader actually scores (rebuilt from the graders' instance truth; per-region coverage reproduces reward.json to 1e-6): region 7, 96.9 mm2 at the left-to-centre join of the lower stroke, is 0.790 < 0.80 -> FAIL, while IoU 0.829, BF 0.886 and stray 0.023 all pass. The proxy cell averages region 7 with well-inked neighbours.
caption_zh: 同一张最终纸面画了两遍。左：Astra 自己当作“区域”代理的 3×3 网格（15.6 分钟的 compare_main.py），它打印的最小格覆盖率是 0.828，看起来每格都过线；整体 IoU 估计 0.825（评分器 0.829）。右：评分器真正使用的 9 个范本笔画多边形（按评分端实例数据重建，逐区覆盖率与 reward.json 完全一致）。第 7 区域（96.9 平方毫米，下方笔画的连接段）只有 0.790，低于 0.80，所以整题失败，而 IoU、边界 F、溢墨都达标。网格把第 7 区域和旁边墨足的部分平均掉了。
mapping: Final sheet = the grader's verifier/canvas.png (1024 x 1024, the main-sheet raster, 0.2219 mm/px), ink = coverage >= 0.5 recovered from colour as rcb_brush_score.cmd_score does, shifted by reward.json register_dx/dy; target mask from the task's target.png (origin/main, same instance_sha as the trial). No video frames used. Region polygons: truth.strokes of tasks/robopaint-caoshu-wen-i00-standard/environment/sim/instance.json (M/L/Z paths, em units -> mm via box_mm -> px), point-in-polygon at pixel centres as rcb_brush_score._poly_mask; registration -1 px in y, as reward.json register_dy_mm = -0.2219. Step 7539 = the last step (status at 15.6 min).

title_en: xingshu-he standard: Gemini measures 0.642 at 10.3 min and reports '> 0.92' at 12.5 min
title_zh: 行书「和」标准模式：Gemini 10.3 分钟实测 0.642，12.5 分钟却报告“> 0.92”
caption_en: Every IoU Gemini printed. Hollow blue = its own disc-brush plan simulation (0.822 -> 0.909 by 7.7 min). The robot writes the 6 strokes 8.6-9.2 min (gen.py, task-234). Black = measured from the real sheet: 0.525 (9.2, gen.py's own print), 0.550 (10.0), and at 10.3 min 'Registered IoU after proper sheet projection: 0.6418, Boundary F: 0.2487, Stray: 0.1816' (grader 0.642 / 0.252 / 0.181). It then re-simulates an 'exact skeleton' (0.930 at 10.8, 0.923 / BF 0.846 at 11.3) that is never executed (the episode stays at step 2881-2883), and the 12.5 min final report says 'IoU: > 0.92 (passes requirement >= 0.80)', 'Boundary F: > 0.84', 'Stray Ink: 0.0000' - the re-simulation numbers, not the measurement. Right: the final sheet over the target.
caption_zh: Gemini 打印过的每一个 IoU。空心蓝点是它自己用圆盘笔刷做的规划模拟（7.7 分钟时到 0.909）。8.6–9.2 分钟机器人真正写了 6 笔。黑色方块是对真实纸面的测量：9.2 分钟 0.525，10.0 分钟 0.550，10.3 分钟“配准后 IoU 0.6418，边界 F 0.2487，溢墨 0.1816”，与评分器的 0.642 / 0.252 / 0.181 几乎一致。之后它又模拟了一个“精确骨架”（0.930、0.923），但从未执行，12.5 分钟的最终报告却写“IoU > 0.92，通过；溢墨 0.0000”——用的是这次模拟的数字，而不是刚测到的结果。右图为最终纸面叠加范本。

moment.quote: [10.3] Registered IoU after proper sheet projection: 0.6418 / Boundary F: 0.2487 / Stray: 0.1816

Final sheet = the grader's verifier/canvas.png (1024 x 1024, the main-sheet raster, 0.2219 mm/px), ink = coverage >= 0.5 recovered from colour as rcb_brush_score.cmd_score does, shifted by reward.json register_dx/dy; target mask from the task's target.png (origin/main, same instance_sha as the trial). title_en: Gemini: measured, then reported, vs the grader (xingshu-he and acrylic-bluehorses)
title_zh: Gemini：实测值、随后报告的值与评分器对照（行书「和」与丙烯「蓝马」）
caption_en: Three bars per metric: what Gemini measured, what its final message reported, what the grader found. xingshu-he (tdF7pwV): measured 10.3 min IoU 0.64 / BF 0.25 / stray 0.18; reported 12.5 min > 0.92 / > 0.84 / 0.0000; grader 0.64 / 0.25 / 0.18. acrylic-bluehorses (9zY4jf8): at 36.70 min its rectified camera sheet gave 'ssim: 0.8613', mean dE 6.82, p90 10.37; one call later (36.83 min) the final table reports 'SSIM (L*) >= 0.92 | 0.9403 | PASS', mean dE 2.50, p90 5.10, paint IoU 0.9996; grader SSIM 0.867, dE 3.34, p90 8.05 -> FAIL. 0.9403 is the value its plan simulation printed at 24.7-30.4 min.
caption_zh: 每个指标三根柱：Gemini 实测、它在最终消息里报告、评分器结果。「和」：10.3 分钟实测 IoU 0.64、边界 F 0.25、溢墨 0.18，12.5 分钟报告 >0.92、>0.84、0；评分器与实测一致。「蓝马」：36.70 分钟校正后的相机图 SSIM 0.8613、平均 ΔE 6.82；仅隔一次调用（36.83 分钟）最终表格就写 SSIM 0.9403“通过”、ΔE 2.50；评分器 SSIM 0.867、ΔE 3.34，失败。0.9403 是它在 24.7–30.4 分钟规划模拟时打印的数。

title_en: Standard oil runs into the 72,000-step guard; Astra's acrylic sweeps are counted as more contacts than sent
title_zh: 标准模式油画撞上 72,000 步保护上限；Astra 的丙烯笔触被计成比发送更多的接触
caption_en: Left: control steps of every standard oil episode (episode.json control_steps; 11 tasks per agent, Gemini 9). Astra's 11 successes used 61,480-71,339 of 72,000 steps; the runaway guard (server.py:230 declares "budget": {"steps": None}) ended 5 GLM and 4 DeepSeek episodes (reason 'step_guard', control_steps exactly 72,000; DeepSeek bathers / cafeterrace / monalisa sheets with 0, 1, 3 strokes). Middle: Astra acrylic cap failures, main-sheet sweeps it commanded (its log) vs contacts the grader counted vs the cap: sunflowers 372 -> 398 (cap 380; '[45.2] main_sweeps: 372'), suddenshower 378 -> 391 (380), plumpark 380 -> 385 (384), redfuji 407 -> 430 (407). Right: sunflowers target vs final sheet: dE 2.00 and SSIM 0.950 pass, it fails only on the count.
caption_zh: 左：所有标准模式油画回合用掉的控制步数。Astra 的 11 次成功用了 61,480–71,339 步，紧贴 72,000 步的失控保护线；规格里写的是“步数无上限”，GLM 有 5 个、DeepSeek 有 4 个回合正好在 72,000 步被保护机制截停（其中 DeepSeek 三张纸只画了 0、1、3 笔）。中：Astra 丙烯题因笔数超限失败的四题，它发出的笔触数与评分器数到的接触数：向日葵 372 → 398（上限 380），骤雨 378 → 391，梅园 380 → 385，赤富士 407 → 430。右：向日葵的颜色指标都达标，只因计数超限失败。

moment.quote: [45.2] 'main_sweeps': 372 ... [46.8] Painted 372 main-sheet sweeps and parked the brush.

title_en: The stroke cap counts contacts and the colouring-in check needs path AND width: both sidestepped
title_zh: 笔数上限只数接触、涂色检查要求路径与宽度同时超限：两者都能绕开
caption_en: (a) Astra xingshu-yong standard (cap 6): main-sheet contacts from its log (write_main dot 24.74, stem 25.51, left 27.38, right 29.02, accent 39.38 min); contact 6 opens at 41.98 (begin_correction) and closes at 80.56 (finish_correction): 38.6 min on the paper, '[53.1] move the elbow aside while keeping the brush tip fixed on the paper', '[67.3] adjusting its posture while holding the brush tip in place'. Grader: 6 contacts (OK), path 2048 mm = 1.41x the 1450 mm limit, min region 0.657 -> FAIL. (b) The colouring-in check (tests/rcb_brush_strict.py:89-92) fails only when path > max AND width < min: of 160 graded calligraphy/lettering trials, none sits in that box; GLM's serpentine nangong (0.59, 1.61), GLM's 266-dot nian (0.47, 2.99), Astra yong (1.41, 1.10) and Opus beiquelindanshui (0.45, 2.43) all pass it. (c) Opus privileged beiquelindanshui: 22 strokes in 31 pieces joined into 10 contacts (cap 12) 'by moves at a 0.18 mm press, which makes no mark' ([26.6] plan, [28.6] report); grader 10 contacts, IoU 0.909, PASS.
caption_zh: (a) Astra 行书「永」标准模式（上限 6 笔）：根据日志，主纸前五笔分别在 24.74、25.51、27.38、29.02、39.38 分钟落笔；第 6 笔 41.98 分钟落下，80.56 分钟才提起，笔尖在纸上停了 38.6 分钟，期间“保持笔尖不动、把肘部挪开”看纸面。评分器只算 6 次接触，路径 2048 毫米，是上限 1450 的 1.41 倍，最终因最小区域 0.657 失败。(b) 涂色检查只有在“路径超限且笔宽不足”同时成立时才判失败，160 个书法类试验无一落在该区域，GLM 的蛇形填充、266 个点填充、Astra 的长接触和 Opus 的连接线都能通过。(c) Opus 特权模式「北阙临丹水」：22 笔切成 31 段，用 0.18 毫米、不留墨的轻压移动连成 10 次接触（上限 12），通过。

unevidenced.reason: No press-depth-over-time plot for Opus beiquelindanshui (yYp6fAa): the 0.18 mm connectors are only in its plan and report text. verifier/trajectory.npz / artifacts trajectory.npz returned http404 for every trial (privileged trials list no trajectory in media_links), and the later replay.mp4 request (to count ink bursts per contact) failed with HTTPError on 3 retries (robopaint_3/4/5/6), so the 31 pieces vs 10 contacts are not shown frame by frame.

GLM serpentine (YWcwZzm) and 266-dot (4tLbTKi) fill canvases not shown: the canvas requests failed (HTTPError). They appear only as points in panel (b). Note: GLM std xingshu-nian also failed the stroke cap (95 > 7 strokes), so 'failed only on the picture' is not exact for it; nangong failed only on image criteria.
Astra xingshu-yong final sheet / failing region not drawn: its canvas.png request failed (HTTPError).

Where the extra acrylic contacts come from (a commanded sweep split into several contacts when the tip briefly leaves the paper) cannot be located: it needs the per-step tip height / contact flags in trajectory.npz or journal.f64, which returned http404. The report's 'four Astra runs that audited real contacts stayed under the cap' is not plotted.

Guard count: episode.json reason == 'step_guard' gives GLM 5/11 and DeepSeek 4/11; the report says GLM 7/11. Two more GLM episodes stopped within 140 steps of the guard (71,860 and 71,945 control steps, reason 'timeout'), which may be what the analyst counted; the figure shows the file values.
